title: Explicit extension from the ring of global sections to module sheaves
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small commutative ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let A be the subring of compatible sections of O, with pointwise operations, and phi the evaluation map from the constant A-presheaf to O. Send a module on the one-object A-site [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data] to its constant module presheaf on C, then apply presheaf scalar extension along phi and module sheafification. Denote this additive functor by T. Evaluation A to O defines, by the two adjunctions, a map T(A) to O. Define T(P) on cochain complexes and its augmentation T(P) to O[0] from any augmentation P to A[0]. For a finite global section list f, the ideal (f) in A maps to (f_i(X)) in O(X). All data are the explicit constructions and adjoint transposes, with no unproved existence choice.

proof.text: Take the subring of compatible tuples, using the inherited commutative ring instance. Evaluation is a ring map natural in X. Ideal.map_span identifies the generated ideals under evaluation.

Construct the constant module presheaf using the identity restrictions. Compose its additive functor with the existing presheaf pullback and sheafification. Their adjunctions give additivity. Adjoint-transpose evaluation A to O to obtain T(A) to O. Use mapHomologicalComplex and singleMapHomologicalComplex to define the extended complex and augmentation.
